### Discovery findings

- Evidence and preliminary recommendations recorded in `docs/admin-workspace-discovery.md`. Shared all-admin reads already exist; creator/initiator identity fields do not. Issue-keyed generation and cost-event upserts are not a per-attempt history. Full-run failures have best-effort generic reporting, while early/prerequisite failures, cancellations, missed reporting and focused runs need independent coverage/reconciliation. Lists are capped at 100 invitations/200 generation records without cursor pagination.
- Preliminary direction: persistent invite-only application admin membership with Neon Auth evaluated against the actual Worker/session boundary; preserve existing coordinator/engine/data while introducing explicit client/attempt/actor entities. No blind database replacement or Access-policy weakening. Missing historical actors must remain unknown unless recovered from verified evidence.
- Validation: source inspection only, including current schemas/handlers, tracker helper, full/focused workflows, existing tests, historical dashboard progress and current Neon documentation. No test/build/browser run, live client data access, provider request, schema provisioning, product-code edit, merge or deployment. Task remains open pending design approval.
